scenario: [LIMP.13.2]: a `lib.Schema` head behaves as a bare one, here for the capture that holds the fact itself. [IRET.10.7]: a `withdraw` in an `after` body names the fact through a fact reference on the capture. Rule `r` matches `jobs.Job j`, and its `after 1_s` body logs `late {j.id}` and withdraws `j`; rule `live` joins a `Probe` with the `Job` of its `n`. A Job with id 7 is asserted and pumped, a Probe of 7 logs `job 7 live`, the clock moves 2 s and the follow-up logs `late 7` and withdraws the Job, and a second Probe of 7 logs nothing. Exactly ["job 7 live", "late 7"]. The first `job 7 live` shows the Job was live for the join, so the second Probe's silence is the withdraw. The break is a capture schema that does not exist for a qualified head, whose load is refused. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.capture_slots`'s `cs_fact` arm, reached through `body_binding_head`.
rules_ds:
import jobs

schema Probe scope explicit:
    n: Int

rule r:
    jobs.Job j
->
    after 1_s:
        log info "late {j.id}"
        withdraw j

rule live:
    Probe p
    jobs.Job j where j.id == p.n
->
    log info "job {j.id} live"

libraries.jobs:
schema Job scope explicit:
    id: Int
